title: Dual-connection midpoint matrix means and their Gauss composition
summary: Nakamura [J. Comput. Appl. Math. 131 (2001)] proved that the arithmetic--harmonic matrix iteration converges quadratically to the geometric matrix mean, the Riemannian midpoint of the affine-invariant metric on positive-definite matrices. We consider the more general problem of when a Riemannian midpoint is a Gauss compound mean. A Riemannian metric and an affine connection determine three midpoint maps associated with the connection, its metric dual, and the Levi--Civita connection.
